data.rationale: The proposal gets the search steps and parameters right (Sail To, Sail From, Dates, Search, guests), but it doesn't mark the optional parameters as optional and it leaves out the key final step of clicking the favorite heart, replacing it with a vague 'read the results' step, so an automation built from it would never complete the real goal.
